context: First application of the pre-registered 2.0x spread screen (D0_TRACE_VALIDITY_SCREEN_PREREG.json) to the Stage 2 30K bicycle data. Room passed all gates. Bicycle passed every hard gate and every other screen; exactly one statistic fired: the final_N relative screen.

forensic_evidence.eval_cadence_parity: The frozen P12 recipe itself evaluates at iterations 500/1000/2000/5000/10000/15000/20000/25000/30000 (+final) in EVERY run (verified from CLEAN_bicycle, CLEAN2_bicycle, ref_bicycle eval_rows). The traced run carries the same eval rows plus additional d0_ckpt rows at 5000..25000; there is no evaluation asymmetry between traced and clean runs.
forensic_evidence.divergence_onset: Every pair - including clean-clean and clean-reference pairs - first separates (n_gs differs by >=1) at iteration 600-800: TRACE|CLEAN at 700, TRACE|CLEAN2 at 600, CLEAN|CLEAN2 at 600, TRACE|ref at 700, CLEAN|ref at 800, CLEAN2|ref at 600. The traced run shows no onset asymmetry; the separation pattern is the known frozen-renderer backward-atomic noise amplified at densification thresholds, identical in character across all pairs.
forensic_evidence.interpretation: Throughout densification (iterations 600-15000) the traced run's cross distances interleave with the clean-clean and clean-reference distances at the same magnitudes (e.g. bucket 1001-5000: TRACE|CLEAN 15549, TRACE|CLEAN2 23023, CLEAN|CLEAN2 15760, CLEAN2|ref 17998). The final_N gap freezes once densification ends. The screen fired because the final-iteration cc envelope is a maximum over only three pairwise distances and the three clean runs happened to converge unusually tightly (max 0.283%), while the trace sits at its trajectory-frozen distance (0.666%). Context from this same campaign: the room CLEAN run deviates from CLEAN2/ref by 1.55% at 30K (clean-clean, no tracer), and the 3K smoke ensembles showed clean-clean relative N spreads up to ~1-2% on both scenes; a 0.67% final_N deviation is well within demonstrated frozen-recipe run-to-run spread.

protocol.step1: Collect exactly +3 frozen-recipe clean bicycle 30K runs (CLEAN3_bicycle, CLEAN4_bicycle, CLEAN5_bicycle; FROZEN trainer, no tracer; launch command identical when resolved to the run_stage12.sh clean arm for scene=bicycle - same trainer and same resolved flag list (--arm c0 --scene bicycle --iterations 30000 plus the fixed tail), verified at deploy; clean-GPU gate 10x30s before launch).
protocol.step2: analyze_stage12.py estimates every within-group envelope over ALL CLEAN*_<scene> replicas present plus the historical P12 reference; the 2.0x screen thresholds and every hard gate are unchanged; the original 3-run values remain computed and reported verbatim.
protocol.step3: Re-run analyze_stage12.py on both scenes; the escalated verdict is FINAL for Stage 2.
protocol.step4: If the screen still fires after the envelope extension: bicycle trace validity is INVALID; the canonical D0 verdict proceeds per d0_verdict.py (trace invalid -> INCONCLUSIVE per precedence); no further escalations; outcome escalated to the operator with the full evidence trail.
protocol.scope_guards: No training semantics are touched; no thresholds are changed; no traced-run data is altered; the extension affects only the ESTIMATE of the intrinsic clean envelope via additional clean draws. This mirrors the Stage 0c smoke resolution (expand ensemble, same rule), which was pre-registered before its own data collection.

finality: One escalation round only, fixed at +3 clean bicycle runs, pre-registered before any new data exists.
